releaseName: Wins that always match your numbers
notes: The Wins page now reads every win straight from your numbers each time you open it. If a payment is deleted or a balance corrected, the page reflects it right away, the same as the rest of the dashboard.
Best month yet now means what it says: a month that took more off your balances than any month in the year before it.
Streak and on-plan wins count your longest run, so a missed month does not erase a run you completed.
